title: [Backend] 通話口をボリュームの中のソケットと中継の補助コンテナで置く（09 の 3.6、Q232）
evaluator_reasons: All 9 acceptance criteria are met by the code and by tests. Host socket bind mount removed (channel_socket*.go deleted; stages.go mounts type=volume <name>-channel readonly). The relay sidecar uses network none, read-only, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, no env, and only the proxy binary plus the channel volume.

Independent re-run in the worktree (non-race): internal/sandbox, internal/sandboxproxy, internal/runner and cmd/evaloom-runner all ok. -race on sandboxproxy plus the Channel|Relay tests of sandbox and runner: ok. A full -race run of cmd/evaloom-runner hit the 600s go test timeout. The non-race run takes 259s, so the timeout comes from race-detector slowdown and is not a regression signal.
The orchestrator's real Docker Desktop test (TestDockerStageChannel) passed with reply {"cancelRequested":true}, and no -relay containers or -channel volumes were left after it.
No public API, DB table, column or config key added. ChannelHandler is internal Go wiring that replaces ChannelPath/WithStageChannel. No leftover references to the old API.

Minor non-blocking notes: the spec 09 3.6 item 5 'next startup sweep' does not exist for channel resources. It does not exist for network sidecars either (pre-existing gap) and is not an acceptance criterion. Cleanup retries forever and logs the first failure to stderr, the same as the network sidecar.

criteria.text: 準備・確かめる・出すの段のコンテナの作成引数に、ホストの Unix ドメインソケットの bind mount が無い
criteria.evidence: sandbox/stages.go: channelMount replaced by channelTarget, which appends type=volume,source=<name>-channel,...,readonly. runner/channel_socket*.go deleted. stage_assembly_test checks that no channel.sock bind and no source=attempt dir are present. channel_test checks that there is no host channel bind mount.

criteria.text: 段ごとに専用のボリュームと、ネットワーク none・読み取り専用・cap-drop ALL・no-new-privileges の補助コンテナが作られ、Runner トークン・鍵・認証情報が補助コンテナの引数と環境変数に無い
criteria.evidence: sandbox/channel.go prepare(): volume create <name>-channel, then container create --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges, with no -e flags and mounts limited to the proxy binary (ro) and the volume. TestStageChannelThroughVolumeAndRelaySidecar asserts these flags and that runner-secret, RUNNER_TOKEN, the token file, HostHome and DataDir are absent from the args and the client env.

criteria.text: 段のコンテナの EVALOOM_CHANNEL がボリュームの中のソケットを指す
criteria.evidence: runner/execution.go sets EVALOOM_CHANNEL=/evaloom/channel/channel.sock. channelTarget requires Base==channel.sock and mounts the volume at its Dir. stage_assembly_test checks the -channel,target=/evaloom/channel mount and the env together, for non-work stages only.

criteria.text: 段から送った cancel_check と出す段の authorize が補助コンテナの標準入出力を通じて Runner に届き、応答が段に返る（偽のランタイムでのテスト）
criteria.evidence: The fake runtime in execution_integration_test runs the production sandboxproxy.ServeChannel over attach stdio, and Runner side RelayChannel connects to HandleChannelRequest. TestStageChannelPublishRelaysToRunnerAPI and others go through testChannelSocket. Re-run passed.

criteria.text: 準備の段と確かめる段の authorize は Runner が拒否する
criteria.evidence: runner/channel.go HandleChannelRequest: authorize with stage != publish -> reject('operation forbidden for stage') and nil -> null -> the sidecar closes without a reply. Existing runner channel tests cover this and passed.

criteria.text: 1行の JSON でない要求と大きさの上限を超える要求は補助コンテナが渡さない
criteria.evidence: sandboxproxy/channel.go serve(): ReadChannelLine with a bounded bufio (64KiB+1) and ValidChannelLine (json.Valid) before forwarding. TestServeChannelPassesOnlyBoundedJSONLines and TestStageChannelRejectsValidJSONBeyondLineLimit check this. The Runner re-checks the length and the JSON.

criteria.text: 段が終わると補助コンテナとボリュームが消える
criteria.evidence: process.go supervise defers channel.cleanup(): container rm --force on the relay, then volume rm with an ls confirmation and retry. The test checks the create/remove order. In the real Docker run, the orchestrator saw 0 leftover -relay containers and 0 -channel volumes.

criteria.text: 補助コンテナかボリュームを作れなかったときは段のコンテナを作らずに sandbox_error になり、理由が段のログに残る
criteria.evidence: container.go run(): channel.prepare runs before createWithSecrets. On failure, fail('stage channel relay unconfirmed', runtimeFailure(err)), and runtimeFailure now keeps the RuntimeError. sandbox_failure_test modes relay-create and relay-volume check: no stage container, error_message has the reason, log artifact has the redacted reason, and error_class is sandbox_error.

criteria.text: 実 Docker のテスト（opt-in）で Docker Desktop 上の確かめる段から通話口に接続して cancel_check の応答を受け取れる
criteria.evidence: channel_docker_test.go (build tag security_docker). The orchestrator ran it independently on Mac mini Docker Desktop: PASS, channel reply {"cancelRequested":true}, with no leftover resources.

notes: Codex usage limit のため worker・5a とも Claude（Opus）。実 Docker のテスト（security_docker、TestDockerStageChannel）は worker とオーケストレータの両方が Docker Desktop で実行して PASS。仕様の穴7点は bd コメント
